what_this_shows: Of 78622 UNGRADABLE months, 77565 carry at least one blank day and 1057 do not (116 have no daily_returns row and 941 carry only a reported-side clause); the six disjoint categories sum to 78622 with no month in two categories. Of the 77565 blank-day months, 3818 also carry a reported-side clause and stay blocked after any fill, so the exact upper bound on months a full UNPRICED fill could make gradable is the 72184 of blank_only_unpriced, below the earlier UNPRICED-first count of 74,791 that the census in row D1-S18 gave.
not_established: Not a promise that any of the 72184 blank_only_unpriced months would match after a fill, and not conditional on whether a vendor covers the securities (round 103 other cell measures that); the bound assumes every UNPRICED blank day is priced and nothing else changes. The month reason text names only the first blank reason in date order, so the blank-reason sets are taken from the daily rows. Sensitivity: 0 UNGRADABLE months carry the clause 'reported value is null' (not one of the four fragments the partition uses), and 0 unknown clauses appear outside the module's emitted texts; 5 blank-day months in daily_returns are not UNGRADABLE months of month_grades and sit outside this census (their verdict was not read).
